scripts.dev: npm run build -w @shannian/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @shannian/api" "npm run dev -w @shannian/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shannian/shared && npm run build -w @shannian/web && npm run build -w @shannian/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @shannian/shared && npm run test -w @shannian/api
